limitations: Scoped review, not organizational AppSec acceptance.
Independent assertions share a user and host with the product; not hostile-process oracle isolation.
Scheduler is finite local modeled collection; no daemon or GitHub/Azure scheduler qualification.
Cleanup assertions cover ordinary deadlines and observed SIGINT/SIGKILL cases; no guarantee under kernel/host failure or unstoppable processes.
Imported device/workflow evidence is caller asserted; no authenticated endpoint or external workflow execution proof.
